messages:
Devon K: hey team :wave: I'm Devon, new today. stuck — can't reach internal docs or dev machines over VPN. Internet works, but ssh to bastion times out. Anyone to ping?

Maria (IT): welcome! what's your OS and VPN client? are you on split-tunnel or full-tunnel? check VPN tray; it should say 'redwood-split' or 'redwood-force'

Devon K: macOS Ventura, using WireGuard profile from admin portal. VPN says connected (redwood-split). curl https://internal.redwood/docs -> DNS timeout. traceroute stops after my ISP.

Sam - eng-infra: can you paste output of `scutil --dns` and `wg show`? Maybe DNS not pushed. also try `nslookup internal.redwood 10.0.0.2`

Devon K: pasted outputs:
```
$ wg show
interface: wg0
  peer: xxxxxx
  latest handshake: 30s ago
  transfer: 12.3 KiB received, 4.5 KiB sent

$ scutil --dns
resolver #1
  nameserver[0] : 8.8.8.8
# no 10.0.0.2
```

Maria (IT): looks like DNS from the profile didn't apply. Reinstall profile from https://admin.redwood/vpn/profiles. If that doesn't work, for testing set AllowedIPs = 0.0.0.0/0 in WireGuard to force tunnel.

Devon K: reinstalled. `scutil --dns` now shows 10.0.0.2. can ping 10.0.1.12 (internal host) but ssh to bastion still times out.

Sam - eng-infra: check your assigned VPN IP; bastion SG allows SSH from 10.100.0.0/22. paste `ifconfig` or `ipconfig getifaddr utun0`.

Devon K: `ipconfig getifaddr utun0` -> 10.100.2.45

Sam - eng-infra: IP is good. try `ssh -p 2222 devon@bastion.redwood.internal` — we rotated public LB IP recently.

Devon K: still times out. traceroute to bastion shows packet stop at my home gateway.

bastion-bot: Bastion LB health: OK. Current public IP 3.12.45.210, port 2222 open. No blocked IPs.

Olivia - People Ops: cc @Maria — double-check your Mac is enrolled in Jamf. Firewall profiles can block VPN routes until device is compliant.

Devon K: Jamf shows device enrolled and profiles installed.

Sam - eng-infra: some ISPs/home routers block UDP or have weird NAT that breaks split-tunnel. Can you try tethering to your phone hotspot?

Devon K: hotspot test works — I can SSH in from hotspot. Looks like ISP/router is the culprit.

Maria (IT): ok. I'll enable forced-tunnel for your account for 24h so you can work from home. DMing you now. I'll also open ticket IT-6123 so we can follow up.

Sam - eng-infra: long term fix: we'll add DNS fallback and a route tweak, but forced-tunnel for now is fine.

Devon K: thanks everyone — appreciate the rapid help :raised_hands: Welcome to Redwood! (joke)

Olivia - People Ops: welcome again :wave: ping me if you want onboarding slack intro meeting.
